# The History

Source: https://globaltassels.org/about-us/the-history/
Last modified: 2024-07-17

In 2014, driven by his passion for education and global development, Dr. Ramos founded Global Tassels, an organization aimed at empowering young people through education and sustainable development. This initiative coincided with the United Nations’ development of the 2015-2030 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), which sought to eradicate global poverty. Aligning with the SDGs, Global Tassels positioned itself as part of a broader movement that inspired entrepreneurs, humanitarians, and philanthropists to join the fight against poverty.

In November 2019, Dr. Ramos announced that he will step down from the presidency, effective June 30, 2020. This then prompted a search for his successors who will continue to lead the organization forward in decades to come.

You can follow the growth of our organization by viewing the below Timeline.

GLOBAL TASSELS PRESIDENTS

Dr. Elvin T. Ramos (2014-2020)

Dr. Shanté Bassett (2020)

Ms. Ashley Johnson (2021)

Dr. Richard Zalman (2022-2024)
